claims.value: Q-Judger is a vision-language model fine-tuned on Qwen3.6-27B for automated evaluation of text-to-image generated images. It evaluates image quality across hierarchical dimensions and outputs structured scores.
claims.evidence: Q-Judger is a vision-language model fine-tuned specifically for automated evaluation of text-to-image generated images.

claims.value: The model uses chain-of-thought reasoning before producing the final JSON output, enabled via a Thinking Mode.
claims.evidence: Thinking Mode: Enabled — the model uses chain-of-thought reasoning before producing the final JSON output
Input: Text prompt + generated image ... Output: Structured JSON with per-dimension scores
Thinking Mode: Enabled — the model uses chain-of-thought reasoning before producing the final JSON output
